finalText:
**Roughly 1291 hits in 94 files.** Three zones must keep `account_id`.

| Zone | Files | Hits | Why frozen |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | 20 | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites edits. |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | 61 | Applied in prod. Editing history breaks the down step. |
| Public API | 2 | 6 | `[docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml:16)` and the wire values in `[lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8)`. Renaming breaks every client. |

That leaves ~1204 hits in `services` and `lib/audit.js`. But 250 of those sit inside SQL strings. Those match real DB columns. They can only change with a new migration that renames the column.

My call. Approve the internal rename. Hold the column rename as its own change.
